scenes.heading: Using email and SMS marketing effectively

sents.d: Using email and SMS marketing effectively
Owned channels like email and SMS often outperform social reach over time.
Unlike social media reach, which platforms can change or reduce at any time, an email or SMS list is a channel you fully control and can reach directly whenever needed.

Beyond the basic welcome and abandoned-cart flows, effective stores often add a post-purchase flow (delivery updates, then a review request), a win-back flow for customers who haven't purchased in a while, and occasional value-driven content, not just promotions.
Segmenting messages based on purchase history or engagement — rather than sending every message to the entire list — typically improves both engagement and unsubscribe rates over blanket messaging.

take: Own your list and send segmented, useful flows.
